scope: Bundled educational Clinical Reference. Not a substitute for professional diagnosis, treatment or emergency care.

safety_contract.title: Medication interaction safety contract
safety_contract.summary: The project does not provide unverified medication-pair interaction advice. This module documents the data and safety boundary for a future verified interaction engine.

rules.title: No unverified pair advice
rules.text: Do not generate interaction severity, dosing changes, stop/start instructions or treatment recommendations from the bundled terminology dataset.

rules.title: Verified source required
rules.text: A future interaction engine must use a maintained, attributable interaction dataset with versioning and evidence provenance.

rules.title: Educational output only
rules.text: Even with a verified dataset, output must present reference information and direct users to qualified clinical review for patient-specific decisions.

rules.title: Offline-safe failure mode
rules.text: If verified interaction data is unavailable, the app must say that the interaction cannot be checked rather than inventing an answer.
